explication: Jido is an Elixir/OTP framework for building autonomous agents. The principal workflow is to define an agent and actions, have the agent transform state and return directives, then run it under AgentServer so the runtime can execute effects and route signals. The graph also preserves documented plugin, strategy, sensor, multi-agent pod, persistence, and observability capabilities. Most connections are documented at the README level; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
